entities.summary: Karl Bushby is an English ex-paratrooper, walking adventurer, and author, currently attempting to be the first person to completely walk an unbroken path around the world. Bushby's trek is known as the Goliath Expedition. He started it in the southern tip of Chile in 1998 and is expected to return in England around 2026.
